"
fetch_aemo_data.py
==================
Fetch real NEM energy + full FCAS price data from AEMO's NEMWeb MMSDM archive.
Run on a networked machine (needs access to nemweb.com.au).

The DISPATCHPRICE table contains energy (RRP) plus all FCAS price columns:
  RRP, RAISE6SECRRP, RAISE60SECRRP, RAISE5MINRRP, RAISE1SECRRP,
  LOWER6SECRRP, LOWER60SECRRP, LOWER5MINRRP, LOWER1SECRRP,
  RAISEREGRRP, LOWERREGRRP
(RAISE1SEC / LOWER1SEC are the Very Fast services, live since Oct 2023.)

This script maps AEMO's column names to the model's short names and writes
data/nem_prices.csv. The model reads it automatically if present.

Usage:
    python model/fetch_aemo_data.py --region QLD1 --year 2024 --month 7

NEMWeb: https://nemweb.com.au/Data_Archive/Wholesale_Electricity/MMSDM/
Regions: NSW1, QLD1, SA1, TAS1, VIC1.
"
